title: In-Place Home Resale Appraisals: Regional Panel Rates by Community
content:
**Regional appraisal panels.** The appraisal charge on an In-Place Home Resale file under the Guaranteed Resale Program carries a regional panel addition, added to the package's appraisal fee into the appraisal sum. The regional panel addition follows the state of the community on the seller's Home-Site Lease, whose appraisal panel sets its own rates: Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows, in Michigan and Pennsylvania, adds 75.00; Saguaro Vista or Bluebonnet Ridge, in Arizona and Texas, adds 40.00; the Florida communities add nothing.

| Community on the Home-Site Lease | State | Regional panel addition |
|---|---|---|
| Cedar Hollow | Michigan | 75.00 |
| Conestoga Meadows | Pennsylvania | 75.00 |
| Saguaro Vista | Arizona | 40.00 |
| Bluebonnet Ridge | Texas | 40.00 |
| Willow Bend Estates | Florida | 0.00 |
| Palmetto Shores | Florida | 0.00 |

The community is the one named on the seller's Home-Site Lease for the site where the home sits.
